checks.finding: _call_with_retry (line 471-512) implements classified retries with full-jitter exponential backoff. Retry classes: TransportError and _TransientResponseError (line 572 _TRANSIENT_RPC_CODES = {-32603}) are retried; RpcProtocolError and non-transient RpcResponseError (any code not in {-32603}) are not retried. _RangeTooLarge is re-raised to the caller. checks.finding: RpcConfig.active_endpoints (line 237-248) returns active endpoints in stable failover order sorted by weight (lower weight first; ties keep declaration order). RpcEndpoint.__post_init__ (line 140-148) translates weight<0 into disabled=True. Non-retryable RpcError on an endpoint is re-raised immediately (failover would not fix a malformed call).
